<description>
The existing max-conflict  cases fail on the parent alone, so the package-level limit check never runs. The new case uses a 0-fee parent so the package is evaluated as a whole. The parent hits the limit and the child's one extra conflict pushes it over.

It kills mutant https://mutanthub.space/mutants/4673 (fails in `test_package_rbf_max_conflicts`):

```diff
diff --git a/src/validation.cpp b/src/validation.cpp
index 57048ac374..2bb5188046 100644
--- a/src/validation.cpp
+++ b/src/validation.cpp
@@ -1067,7 +1067,7 @@ bool MemPoolAccept::PackageRBFChecks(const std::vector<CTransactionRef>& txns,
     // This limit is not increased in a package RBF. Use the aggregate number of transactions.
     CTxMemPool::setEntries all_conflicts;
     if (const auto err_string{GetEntriesForConflicts(*child_ws.m_ptx, m_pool, direct_conflict_iters,
-                                                     all_conflicts)}) {
+                                                     all_conflicts)}; false) {
         return package_state.Invalid(PackageValidationResult::PCKG_POLICY,
                                      "package RBF failed: too many potential replacements", *err_string);
     }
```
</description>

<commits>
9365acce49 test: cover package RBF conflict limit

The existing max-conflict cases fail on the parent alone, so the
package-level conflict limit check in PackageRBFChecks never runs.

Add a case with a zero fee parent so the package is evaluated as a
whole. The parent conflicts with 100 clusters and the child adds one
extra, which exceeds the limit.
</commits>
